subject.title: [Bug] WebChat: optimistic USER messages are lost (not just hidden) when chat.send returns before the durable transcript lands — full-replace history reconcile drops them

question: Should `chat.send` keep ACKing once dispatch is accepted, or should a started ACK require durable user-turn transcript visibility/progress before returning?
rationale: The UI mitigation is already present, but changing the gateway ACK/durable boundary affects core session semantics and the existing candidate PR is broad and not land-ready.

options.title: Adopt durable/progress ACK contract
options.body: Port the useful part of the gateway candidate through the shared user-turn recorder so started means durable visibility or guaranteed progress, with focused busy-session and rollover proof.

options.title: Keep admission-only ACK
options.body: Maintain the current ACK behavior and rely on UI pending-message preservation, accepting that durable transcript visibility may lag behind started.

options.title: Replace the open candidate
options.body: Close or pause the broad candidate PR and ask for a narrower recorder-boundary PR once the contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Adopt durable/progress ACK contract
recommendation.body: Port the useful part of the gateway candidate through the shared user-turn recorder so started means durable visibility or guaranteed progress, with focused busy-session and rollover proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision centers on the shared user-turn transcript recorder and gateway persistence boundary they recently centralized.
